### 📦 Environment

Vercel

### 📌 Version

1.14.3

### 💻 Operating System

Windows

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

### 🐛 Bug Description

The Auto Generate isn't using the correct language to do the requests, making the response be in the incorrect language.
Sometimes it didn't show any response at all, and a infinite loading animation appears on the field.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e21612b4-3e7c-4d03-bb86-14195d803b76

Auto Icon displaying the prompt response in the place of the icon

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/82ba12b9-091c-41af-81ca-915eef973b57

Auto Icon didn't received the response. This happens with others fields as well

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eaf6442b-8455-463b-96f9-bbd0033ba41c

Auto Generate response in Chinese instead of English


### 📷 Recurrence Steps

1. Open an assistant session settings
2. Click on `Auto Generate` button
3. Check the generated Assistant fields

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

The Auto Generate should use the selected language in the settings.

### 📝 Additional Information

The issue is seems to be random, models like gpt4o and claude3.5-sonnet tend to better handle the request in chinese and answering it in the correct language, but model like gemini-1.5turbo, llama3.1 70b, gemma2 9b and others, sometimes ignore the language that should be used.
Another issue related with the Auto Generate is that sometimes a response is placed inside the icons field, or it add invisble break symbols in the title and description.

This is the completion request of one of the Auto Generate requests

  "model": "llama-3.1-70b-versatile",

      "content": "输入: {你是一名文案大师，帮我为一些设计 / 艺术作品起名，名字需要有文学内涵，注重精炼和赋子意境，表达作品的情景氛国，使名称既简洁又富有诗意。} [zh-CN]",
      "role": "user"
    },
    {
      "content": "起名,写作,创意",
      "role": "assistant"
    },
    {
      "content": "输入: {You are a professional translator proficient in Simplified Chinese, and have participated in the translation work of the Chinese versions of The New York Times and The Economist. Therefore, you have a deep understanding of translating news and current affairs articles. I hope you can help me translate the following English news paragraphs into Chinese, with a style similar to the Chinese versions of the aforementioned magazines.} [zh-CN]",
      "role": "user"

[ParseFileToChunks] error: d [TRPCClientError]: Unsupported GET-request to mutation procedure at path "file.parseFileToChunks"

    code: 'METHOD_NOT_SUPPORTED',
    httpStatus: 405,
    path: 'file.parseFileToChunks'
  },
  [cause]: undefined

```

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

Special steps during deploy:
docker arguments:


`docker run -it -d -p 127.0.0.1:3210:3210 --network="host"  --------- (rest are same)`

(Set --network="host" to connect to local pgsql)

Set nft tables to drop all traffic from outside to port 3210

```
table ip filter {
    chain input {
        type filter hook input priority 0; policy accept;
        iifname != "lo" tcp dport 3210 counter drop
    }
}
```

Set Apache httpd to do reverse proxy


```
<VirtualHost *:80>
    ServerName my.domain.example.com

    ProxyPreserveHost On
    ProxyPass / http://localhost:3210/
    ProxyPassReverse / http://localhost:3210/

    ErrorLog ${APACHE_LOG_DIR}/my.domain.example.com.log
    CustomLog ${APACHE_LOG_DIR}/my.domain.example.com-access.log combined
</VirtualHost>
```

Last use certbot to get a CA, also let it auto config the https redirect.

body:
### 📦 Environment

Docker

### 📌 Version

v1.15.18

### 💻 Operating System

Ubuntu, Other Linux

### 🌐 Browser

Firefox

### 🐛 Bug Description

When I upload image into chat, and hit run, the image (especially a large image) will take a few seconds to load it into the chat. At the same time, the llm model will NOT see the image, and cause error like "please provide image".

Wait a few seconds, until the image is fully loaded (able to see the full preview in chat), then rerun the conversation, and the llm would be able to correctly recognize the image.

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

Upload an image (>=1mb) to a chat (I upload to one of my chat bot) + ask the llm to describe the image, until the image is fully uploaded, hit send.

The image preview (in the chat) will show blank, and need a few seconds to show the preview of image. 

At the same time, llm will respond something like "please provide the image you want me to describe.

Wait a few seconds, until the image preview is fully loaded in side the conversation, rerun the llm, now it can correctly describe the image. 

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

I expected (a simple solution) is do NOT send anything through the api until the image is fully loaded. 

### 📝 Additional Information

Docker on Debian 12, with local pgsql installation.

title: [Request] Switch Between URL and Base64 Modes for Image Input in Server Mode
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

In server mode, I need the ability to switch between URL and Base64 modes for image input via configuration options. This feature is crucial for addressing the issue where S3 (minio) cannot be accessed via the external network in a private deployment.

#### Use Case
In private deployments, particularly when using S3-compatible storage solutions like minio, images stored in the bucket are often not accessible from the external network. This limitation hinders the ability to use URL-based image inputs in language models such as OpenAI's API. By providing a configuration option to use Base64 encoded images instead of URLs, we can ensure seamless operation in both public and private deployment environments.


#### Benefits
- Provides flexibility in deployment environments.
- Ensures compatibility with private storage solutions like minio.
- Enhances the robustness of the server mode by accommodating different image input methods.



### 🧐 Proposed Solution

1. Introduce a configuration option in the server settings to toggle between URL and Base64 modes for image input.
2. When the Base64 mode is enabled, the server should accept Base64 encoded images and decode them appropriately before processing.
3. Ensure that the switch between modes is seamless and does not affect the existing functionality for URL-based inputs.

### 📝 Additional Information

This feature would greatly enhance the usability of the server mode in restricted network environments and facilitate easier integration with private storage solutions.

For reference, please see the related PR: [PR #3370](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/pull/3370).

Thank you for considering this feature request. I look forward to your feedback and am available for any further clarification or discussion.

### 🥰 需求描述

可以使用除 Cleak 之外的身份认证服务，比如 Authing、 Auth0、 GitHub OAuth、OpenID 等.

### 🧐 解决方案

通过以下环境变量设置，*代表着身份认证服务：
```
AUTH_SERVICE_*=<true>
AUTH_SERVICE_*_URL=<true>
AUTH_SERVICE_*_APPID=<appid>
AUTH_SERVICE_*_APPKEY=<appkey>
```

### 📝 补充信息

_No response_

title: [Request] support other embedding?
body:

目前除了openai的text embedding，有很多优秀的向量模型。例如silliconcloud支持的bge-m3等
给像我这样的非openai ai(google gemini user)用户有可选择的余地

### 🧐 解决方案

建议追加一个或两个其他模型，后期可以开放sdk给用户自己对接，例如你规定api的格式，用户自己提供api url。

title: [Bug] Undeployed database alterations found
body:
### 📦 Environment

Docker

### 📌 Version

v1.17.3

### 💻 Operating System

Ubuntu

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome, Safari

### 🐛 Bug Description

When using docker compose, logto throws this error and exits:

```
> cli
> logto db seed --swe
info Seeding skipped
npm notice
npm notice New patch version of npm available! 10.8.2 -> 10.8.3
npm notice Changelog: https://github.com/npm/cli/releases/tag/v10.8.3
npm notice To update run: npm install -g npm@10.8.3
npm notice
> start
> cd packages/core && NODE_ENV=production node .
(node:44) ExperimentalWarning: Importing JSON modules is an experimental feature and might change at any time
(Use `node --trace-warnings ...` to show where the warning was created)
cache    warn No Redis client initialized, skipping
pre      error Found undeployed database alterations, you must deploy them first by npm run alteration deploy command.
 See https://docs.logto.io/docs/references/using-cli/database-alteration for reference.
index    error Error while initializing app:

title: [Request] 增加请求头作为身份验证方式
body:
### 🥰 需求描述

在内部部署（如团队或个人工具）的场景下，LobeChat经常被部署在反向代理的后端。以上场景中，很多反向代理过程中已经集成了单点登录功能，可以通过向后端传输"X-REMOTE-USER"等请求头来传递已通过验证的用户信息。LobeChat的自部署数据库版可否添加一种模式，直接通过读取用户定义的请求头来获取用户名、电子邮件、头像、UUID？个人认为这一功能将极大便利LobeChat作为团队工作台的集成工具之一出现。

### 🧐 解决方案

## 方式一
- 服务部署时，指定`AUTH_BY_HEADER=TRUE`,`AUTH_USERNAME_HEADER=X-REMOTE-USER-NAME`,`AUTH_USERID_HEADER=X-REMOTE-USER-ID`,`AUTH_USEREMAIL_HEADER=X-REMOTE-USER-EMAIL`,`AUTH_USERFAVICON_HEADER=X-REMOTE-USER-FAVICON`等变量；
- 服务运行中，直接读取访问者的对应请求头，完成无感身份认证。
- 个人认为此方法非常普适，但可能安全性略差，需要反向代理服务器注意请求头的过滤，不过这是部署团队自己要注意的事情了。

## 方式二
- 很多团队的反向代理中认证方式也是OIDC或OAuth2.0，
- 通过读取其传递的`X-REMOTE-USER-TOKEN`等类似的OAuth2.0 Token，再通过Token从SSO拉取用户信息来完成无感身份认证。
- 个人认为此方法泛用性较差，可能不兼容团队的一些情况，但安全性略高，可以预防伪造请求头攻击。

## 目的
主要就是为了免除登录团队工具之后，跳转或通过内嵌页面来到LobeChat后还得再登陆一次的繁琐。

### 📝 补充信息

对于我提到的”集成了身份认证的反向代理服务器“，可以以[oauth2-proxy/oauth2-proxy](https://github.com/oauth2-proxy/oauth2-proxy)做个参考，当然，很多团队相关的功能是自己实现的，集成在自己的工作台里。
不太了解项目的构成，也暂时没时间细细阅读代码，所以无法自己动手修改。不过个人认为此功能还是有很大应用前景的。如蒙关注，感激不尽。

title: [Request] Add profile panel for auth system
body:
### 🥰 需求描述

**希望非clerk的auth方案增加类似clerk点击头像打开profile panel的功能**
- 目前db版用户需要修改密码、邮箱、第三方绑定等信息需要前往auth对应页面或者需要auth管理员才可以操作，希望针对不同auth系统集成对应的profile panel，方便用户自己就可以修改用户密码等信息而不需要联系auth管理员或者需要管理员单独发auth的登录链接进行修改。


### 🧐 解决方案

目前`casdoor`、`logto`等都有自己的profile page，针对有profile page的auth可以增加用户点击头像`打开一个新页面`指向对应auth系统自带的profile page方便用户自己修改相关`个人信息`。如果考虑到page的统一性，可以作为环境变量（`AUTH_PROFILE_PAGE`）配置，如果配置了prifile page那就点击头像可以打开对应页面，如果对应环境变量为空可以不做处理。

### 📝 补充信息

对于API代理商和小集体用lobehub作为唯一AI Chat工具的场景，让用户可以自己修改维护自己的个人用户信息比较有必要，避免了用户因为需要修改用户信息（`用户密码`、`邮箱`、`手机`、`三方绑定`等）而需要联系管理员等不必要的烦恼。一定程度用户自己把握个人信息也提高的系统的安全性。
 #### Profile Page(欢迎补充其他lobehub适配的Auth的page)
- casdoor:`<domain>/account`
- logto:`<admin.domain.com>/console/profile`

title: [Bug] 默认助手的 max_token 设置无效
body:
### 📦 Environment

Docker

### 📌 Version

1.17.7 - lobechat-db

### 💻 Operating System

Windows

### 🌐 Browser

Edge

### 🐛 Bug Description

# Issue: 默认助手的 max_token 设置无效

**版本** :
1.17.7 数据库版本

## 问题描述

在使用 Lobechat 版本 1.17.7 时，我发现默认助手的 `max_token` 参数设置不生效。无论如何调整该参数，实际响应中的 token 数量并未发生变化。


### 📷 Recurrence Steps

1. 打开 Lobechat 应用。
2. 导航到默认助手设置界面。
3. 尝试启用 `max_token` 的值（例如，启用max_token）。
4. 保存设置，并尝试与默认助手进行对话。

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

在启用 `max_token` 设置后，
`{
  "error": {
    "message": "Request validation failed. At 'max_tokens': Required",
    "type": "proxy_validation_error"
  }
}`
错误应该消失

实际结果是 `max_token` 参数不生效，Request validation failed. At 'max_tokens': Required"错误仍然发生

### 📝 Additional Information

F12查看请求也能发现请求body中没有相关参数。
默认助手相关的所有参数均未生效，包括系统提示词。

title: [Request] 提供一个ZITADEL 身份验证服务本地部署参考
body:
### 🥰 需求描述

ZITADEL 身份验证服务本地部署

### 🧐 解决方案

docker compose
```
services:
  network-service:
    image: alpine
    container_name: lobe-network
    ports:
      - '9000:9000'  # MinIO API
      - '9001:9001'  # MinIO Console
      - '8080:8080' # Zitadel Console
      - '3210:3210' # LobeChat
    command: tail -f /dev/null
    networks:
      - lobe-network

  postgresql:
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16
    container_name: lobe-postgres
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - './data:/var/lib/postgresql/data'
    environment:
      - 'POSTGRES_DB=lobechat'
      - 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=uWNZugjBqixf8dxC'
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U postgres']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: always
    networks:
      - lobe-network

  minio:
    image: minio/minio
    container_name: lobe-minio
    network_mode: 'service:network-service'
    volumes:
      - './s3_data:/etc/minio/data'
    environment:
      - 'MINIO_ROOT_USER=YOUR_MINIO_USER'
      - 'MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=YOUR_MINIO_PASSWORD'
      - 'MINIO_API_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3210'
    restart: always
    command: >
      server /etc/minio/data --address ":9000" --console-address ":9001"

  zitadel:
    restart: 'always'
    image: 'ghcr.io/zitadel/zitadel:latest'
    container_name: lobe-zitadel
    network_mode: 'service:network-service'
    command: 'start-from-init --masterkey "MasterkeyNeedsToHave32Characters" --tlsMode disabled'
    environment:
      - 'ZITADEL_DATABASE_POSTGRES_HOST=postgresql'
      - 'ZITADEL_DATABASE_POSTGRES_PORT=5432'
      - 'ZITADEL_DATABASE_POSTGRES_DATABASE=zitadel'
      - 'ZITADEL_DATABASE_POSTGRES_USER_USERNAME=zitadel'
      - 'ZITADEL_DATABASE_POSTGRES_USER_PASSWORD=zitadel'
      - 'ZITADEL_DATABASE_POSTGRES_USER_SSL_MODE=disable'
      - 'ZITADEL_DATABASE_POSTGRES_ADMIN_USERNAME=postgres'
      - 'ZITADEL_DATABASE_POSTGRES_ADMIN_PASSWORD=uWNZugjBqixf8dxC'
      - 'ZITADEL_DATABASE_POSTGRES_ADMIN_SSL_MODE=disable'
      - 'ZITADEL_EXTERNALSECURE=false'
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy

  lobe:
    image: lobehub/lobe-chat-database
    container_name: lobe-database
    network_mode: 'service:network-service'
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy
      network-service:
        condition: service_started
      minio:
        condition: service_started
      zitadel:
        condition: service_started
    env_file:
      - .env
    restart: always

volumes:
  data:
    driver: local
  s3_data:
    driver: local

networks:
  lobe-network:
    driver: bridge
```
.env
```
# LobeChat 域名
APP_URL=http://localhost:3210

# Postgres 相关，也即 DB 必须的环境变量
# 用于加密敏感信息的密钥，可以使用 openssl rand -base64 32 生成
KEY_VAULTS_SECRET=Kix2wcUONd4CX51E/ZPAd36BqM4wzJgKjPtz2sGztqQ=
# Postgres 数据库连接字符串
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:uWNZugjBqixf8dxC@postgresql:5432/lobechat

# NEXT_AUTH 相关
AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3210/api/auth
NEXT_AUTH_SECRET=NX2kaPE923dt6BL2U8e9oSre5RfoT7hg
NEXT_AUTH_SSO_PROVIDERS=zitadel
AUTH_ZITADEL_ID=285945938244075523
AUTH_ZITADEL_SECRET=hkbtzHLaCEIeHeFThym14UcydpmQiEB5JtAX08HSqSoJxhAlVVkyovTuNUZ5TNrT
AUTH_ZITADEL_ISSUER=http://localhost:8080

# MinIO S3 配置
S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=        
S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=
S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000
S3_BUCKET=lobe 
S3_PUBLIC_DOMAIN=http://localhost:9000
S3_ENABLE_PATH_STYLE=1
```

password: Password1!

body:
### 📦 Environment

Vercel

v1.19.22

Windows

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

title: Infinite Loading Issue
body:
### 📦 Environment

Vercel

### 📌 Version

v1.19.22

### 💻 Operating System

Windows

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

### 🐛 Bug Description

After following the deployment instructions with Vercel and Clerk, when accessing the application via [https://app.adrien-murillo.com](https://app.adrien-murillo.com), the page gets stuck on an infinite loading screen. The user interface does not load, and no errors are displayed on the screen. The application fails to fully load, preventing any interaction or use of LobeChat's features.

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

1. **Access the Application**:
   - Open Google Chrome.
   - Navigate to [https://app.adrien-murillo.com](https://app.adrien-murillo.com).

2. **Observe the Behavior**:
   - The page displays a loading screen with an animation (e.g., spinning wheel).
   - The loading screen persists indefinitely.
   - No part of the user interface appears.

3. **Check the Browser Console**:
   - Open Developer Tools (F12).
   - Go to the "Console" tab.
   - Note any error or warning messages (see Additional Information section).

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

I expected the application to load normally, displaying the complete user interface, with the ability to sign in via Clerk and use all features provided by LobeChat, including sending messages, creating chats, etc.

### 📝 Additional Information

- **Browser Console**:
  - **Error 1**: `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 500 (Internal Server Error)`.
  - **Error 2**: `Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read property 'user' of undefined at App.js:45`.
  - **Warning**: `Some cookies are misusing the recommended “SameSite“ attribute`.

- **Vercel Logs**:
  - No significant errors appear in the deployment logs.
  - Server functions seem to be deployed correctly.

- **Environment Variables Configuration**:
  - All required environment variables have been configured as per documentation, including:
    - `CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET`
    - `CLERK_SECRET_KEY`
    - `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`
    - `DATABASE_URL`
    - `S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID`
    - `S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`
    - `S3_BUCKET`
    - `S3_ENDPOINT`
    - `S3_PUBLIC_DOMAIN`
    - `APP_URL`
    - `NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVICE_MODE`

- **Troubleshooting Attempts**:
  - **Clerk Configuration Check**:
    - Public and secret keys match those provided by Clerk.
    - The webhook is correctly configured with the URL `https://app.adrien-murillo.com/api/webhooks/clerk`.
  - **Testing on Different Browsers**:
    - The same issue occurs on Firefox and Edge.
  - **Clearing Cache and Using Incognito Mode**:
    - No improvement observed.
  - **Checking CORS Permissions for S3**:
    - CORS rules are configured to allow requests from `https://app.adrien-murillo.com`.

- **Additional Observations**:
  - It seems that the application fails to fetch certain resources or data needed for the initial load.
  - Network requests in the "Network" tab of the Developer Tools show failures on certain APIs.

- **Hypotheses**:
  - The issue might be related to a misconfiguration in Clerk or an incompatibility with the deployed version.
  - A communication issue with the database or S3 storage could also be a contributing factor.

title: [Request] 在 rag 中包含文件的元信息
body:
### 🥰 需求描述

现有的单个文档上传解析虽然已经够用，但是有一个比较明显的缺陷是没有在提问时中携带文件的元信息，例如文件名和文件的大小，在例如ChatGPT官方的文档解析功能中，我们提问AI, 我们上传了一个什么样的文件？文件名是什么？文件拓展名是什么？文件的大小是多大？AI 都是可以知道的。但是 Lobe 中的 rag 并没携带这些信息，导致了模型并不知道我们的文件元信息，缺少了一部分数据参考，希望可以添加这个比较简单的功能，可以让AI更好的理解我们上传的整个文件的整体是什么样的，我们上传了一个什么文件，而不是只是作为简单的将文件切割然后将分块添加到上下文中

### 🧐 解决方案

可以通过修改提示词，将文档的元信息包含到我们发送的数据分块中，更利于 AI 理解我们究竟在对一个什么样的文件进行提问

title: [Bug] github鉴权，无法将获取到的用户名和头像传入web前端并显示
body:
### 📦 部署环境

Docker

### 📌 软件版本

lobehub/lobe-chat-database:1.19.34

### 💻 系统环境

Other Linux

### 🌐 浏览器

Chrome

### 🐛 问题描述

github鉴权，无法将获取到的用户名和头像传入web前端，只能将获取到邮箱作为用户名，头像则为默认占位符。

我通过脚本确认了通过使用和`项目本身给出的实现`相同的接口获取方法，我的github api是能获取到用户名和头像的。既然接口获取方法没问题，我的api也没问题，那么应该是在`把获取到的用户名和头像传递到web前端的相应绑定点中`的这个过程里出现了问题吧

测试脚本如下：
```
import os
import requests
from flask import Flask, redirect, request, url_for

app = Flask(__name__)

# 配置你的 GitHub OAuth App 的 client_id 和 client_secret
CLIENT_ID = 'your_github_client_id'
CLIENT_SECRET = 'your_github_client_secret'
# 回调 URL，必须与 GitHub OAuth App 的设置一致
REDIRECT_URI = 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/callback'

# GitHub 授权 URL
AUTH_URL = f'https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize?client_id={CLIENT_ID}&redirect_uri={REDIRECT_URI}&scope=read:user%20user:email'

# GitHub 获取访问令牌的 URL
TOKEN_URL = 'https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token'
# GitHub 用户信息 API
USER_API_URL = 'https://api.github.com/user'


# 第一步：重定向到 GitHub 授权页面
@app.route('/')
def index():
    return redirect(AUTH_URL)


# 第二步：处理 GitHub 的回调，接收授权码并用它换取访问令牌
@app.route('/callback')
def callback():
    code = request.args.get('code')  # GitHub 返回的授权码

    if not code:
        return "Error: No code provided"

    # 第三步：使用授权码请求 GitHub 的访问令牌
    token_response = requests.post(TOKEN_URL, headers={'Accept': 'application/json'}, data={
        'client_id': CLIENT_ID,
        'client_secret': CLIENT_SECRET,
        'code': code,
        'redirect_uri': REDIRECT_URI,
    })

    if token_response.status_code != 200:
        return f"Error getting token: {token_response.text}"

    # 从响应中提取访问令牌
    token_json = token_response.json()
    access_token = token_json.get('access_token')

    if not access_token:
        return "Error: No access token found"

    # 第四步：使用访问令牌请求 GitHub 用户信息
    user_response = requests.get(USER_API_URL, headers={
        'Authorization': f'token {access_token}',
        'Accept': 'application/json',
    })

    if user_response.status_code != 200:
        return f"Error fetching user info: {user_response.text}"

    # 返回用户信息
    user_info = user_response.json()
    return f"User Info: {user_info}"


if __name__ == '__main__':
    # 在本地运行应用
    app.run(debug=True)
```

相关讨论： #4116

数据库版，使用github鉴权，登录。

### 🚦 期望结果

web前端正常显示对应github账户的用户名和头像

### 📝 补充信息

github app只开放了邮箱权限，用户名和头像是公开访问的，不用额外授权。

title: [Bug] 设置主题之后，刷新网页会存在在不同主题之间来回切换的效果
body:
### 📦 部署环境

Official Preview, Docker

### 📌 软件版本

latest

### 💻 系统环境

Windows

### 🌐 浏览器

Chrome

### 🐛 问题描述

当设置的主题色和系统相反时(lobechat设置为浅色，windows颜色模式设置为深色)，刷新网页时，会出现先深色后浅色的情况。我在lobechat.com，本地以及自建的Docker中也发现了这个问题。
我追踪了一下，出现这种情况的原因是(lobechat的主题为浅色，windows系统色为深色)：
1. 当处于浅色模式时刷新网页，这一步会将cookie中的LOBE_THEME_APPEARANCE修改为dark
2. 再次刷新网页时，会出现先深色然后再切换到浅色的情况，并且会将LOBE_THEME_APPEARANCE修改为light
3. 后面会按照上面两步一直循环

我在Chrome和Edge浏览器中都发现了这个问题。

### 📷 复现步骤

1. 在windows中将颜色模式选择为深色
2. 在LobeChat将主题选择为浅色(cookie中LOBE_THEME_APPEARANCE值为light)
3. 刷新网页。这次刷新不会出现深色到浅色变化的情况，但是会将cookie中LOBE_THEME_APPEARANCE的值设置dark
4. 再次刷新网页，这一步就会出现主题色先深色后浅色的情况，LOBE_THEME_APPEARANCE的值变为了light
5. 后面会一直在2~4之间循环。windows设置为浅色，lobechat设置为深色，同样也会出现这种情况

title: [Bug] both gemini-1.5-pro-001and gemini-1.5-pro-002 reach errorcode 429 when prompt contains ~30k tokens.
body:
### 📦 Environment

Vercel

### 📌 Version

1.21.3

### 💻 Operating System

Ubuntu

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

### 🐛 Bug Description

Hi, 

Recently I (google gemini free-tier user) constantly encounter errorcode 429 when using both gemini-1.5-pro-001 and gemini-1.5-pro-002 together with knowledge base, even I take 2~10 mintues break upon every 429 error.

After a while I found that if I do following (1~2 with knowledge base on, 3 with knowledge base off):
1. switch to gemini-1.5-pro-exp-0827 or
2. limit conversation history to reduce token used to drastically smaller than 30k while stick to gemini-1.5-pro-001/002 or
3. switch off knowledge base, no limitation on conversation history (token used is nearly 30k), use gemini-1.5-pro-001/002

1~3 then all good. 

In summary, it seems that **knowledge base together with ~30k token prompts are somewhat in conflict with gemini-1.5-pro-001/002**. I'm not sure if this is caused by Google but given that without knowledge base I can use gemini-1.5-pro-001/002 with ~30k token prompts (see 3.) vs. I can also use gemini-1.5-pro-exp-0827 together with knowledge base and 30k token prompts (see 1.), my guess would be there shoudn't be any bug on the google side.

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

1. open a topic and use knowledge base (in my case I used a 6-page paper).
2. do some chats till tokens used reach ~30k.
3. keep chatting with knowledge base and tokens used ~30k, you will soon see 429 error and it is not recoverable.
4. If you want to see if this is a bug in google side, simply switch model to gemini-1.5-pro-exp-0827 and everything seems fine.

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

No 429 error

### 📝 Additional Information

title: [Bug] 在一个话题下只有第一次发送消息能提交图片
body:
### 📦 部署环境

Docker

### 📌 软件版本

database 1.22.0

### 💻 系统环境

Windows

### 🌐 浏览器

Firefox

### 🐛 问题描述

我注意到在一个话题中，只有第一次上传的图片可以被正常合并到请求中发送（上传方式为复制图片并在输入框中粘贴）
哪怕是在完成第一次对话后将全部对话删除再进行完全相同的输入，也不能产生带有图片链接的正常请求。

具体如图：
第一次正常请求：
![图片](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/33b74144-f518-44d6-bf87-cbde9c1971ee)
删除所有对话框后的第二次请求异常：
![图片](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7050bdff-3115-4b2d-9501-4dc085afe433)
图中请求中可见的用户输入文字来自模板，经过测试，无论有无模板、system prompt和历史消息限制条数均对该问题无影响。
与模型无关。Claude也会如此。

![图片](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e677da27-0ed7-45af-ad1c-bdec8f1d622a)


### 📷 复现步骤

方法一（我发现该问题的路径）
1.选择一个多模态大模型
2.复制一张图，在输入框中Ctrl+V粘贴并上传
3.写一段prompt并发送
4.逐个删除以上对话框
5.重复2和3
方法二：
1.选择一个多模态大模型
2.复制一张图，在输入框中Ctrl+V粘贴并上传
3.写一段prompt并发送
4.选择另一张图
5.重复2和3

### 🚦 期望结果

无论是上传的第几张图都能正常把URL发送给API提供商

### 📦 部署环境

Vercel

### 📌 软件版本

v1.22.6

### 💻 系统环境

Windows

### 🌐 浏览器

Edge

### 🐛 问题描述

在一周前我的LobeChat是没有使用server部署模式的，我在Vercel中配置了OpenAI的API-Key，同时开启了ACCESS_CODE访问密码，这样就能够方便我和我的小伙伴快速通过访问密码来进行对话，访客则需要输入自己的OpenAI API-Key以使用我的LobeChat。
一周后我决定将我的LobeChat部署为server模式，因为在原来的模式下不支持上传解析文件，于是我按照官方文档的教程，配置好了Clerk、S3存储桶、Postgres数据库......
然而我这么操作后，我发现，只要是注册后的用户，都可以不输入ACCESS_CODE而直接开始对话，这让我不得不紧急关闭Clerk的注册功能。

### 📷 复现步骤

正常以server模式配置好Vercel的环境变量，同时填写ACCESS_CODE的环境变量，部署就会发现，用户可以正常注册登录，而且可以【**直接开始对话**】，而并不需要输入ACCESS_CODE，在设置中的【访问密码】形同虚设。
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c39bd59d-a835-405f-8cc0-ee44667dbcec)


### 🚦 期望结果

我期望在server模式下，启用ACCESS_CODE，能够像普通模式一样，弹出需要填写密码，就像这样：

## Description

I first noticed this while working in an out-of-tree platform, React Native MacOS. Running `npx react-native run-macos` did not start Metro automatically. Filed the full set of details originally in their project at https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-macos/issues/2208

But I got a notificaiton about the "removing run on iOS/Android key handlers" discussion about this comment: https://github.com/react-native-community/discussions-and-proposals/discussions/821#discussioncomment-10852786

> not opposed to this change (alongside the above, it also seems less confusing to only have one entry point), but I do want to note that, at least for me, yarn android doesn't seem to start Metro? I'm using Ubuntu 24.04/GNOME Terminal if it matters - I swear it did work (at least occasionally) on Windows but I'm not certain about that

And I thought it might be related to what I had seen on React Native MacOS.

## Reproducible Demo

Follow the React Native macOS [setupd](https://microsoft.github.io/react-native-windows/docs/rnm-getting-started) (for the most part, the current docs are actually a little out of date, but this will be the steps for an up-to-date RN project)

1. npx @react-native-community/cli init macapp
2. cd macapp
3. npx react-native-macos-init
4. npx react-native run-macos

The app will build, but not start Metro: 

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a6164e01-f742-4283-89ce-492c7fbb4935)

Not a big deal, I can just run `yarn start`, then tap "reload"

Everything works great from there. I also did not have this issue when following the instructions for RN 0.71:

```
npx react-native@latest init <projectName> --version 0.71.0
```

Reproducer repo: https://github.com/coolsoftwaretyler/rnms-issue-repro

It sounds like this is happening on in-tree platforms as well based on @Rexogamer's comment in that discussion post, but I don't have a reproduction for that at the moment.

Thanks for your work and consideration!

title: [Request] Support importing browser chat history to server deployment
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

Currently, users of the browser version of Lobe Chat accumulate chat history that cannot be easily migrated when switching to the server deployment version. This creates friction for users who wish to retain their past conversations. By adding support to import chat history from the browser to the server, we can streamline the migration process, making it easier for users to move their data seamlessly between platforms.

### 🧐 Proposed Solution

I would like to see an import feature in the server deployment version of Lobe Chat that allows users to easily upload their chat history from the browser version.
When chat history is detected locally in the browser, the user should be prompted that historical chat records are available, and be given the option to either back up or migrate the data. If the user selects "Back Up," it would essentially perform an export function. If the user selects "Migrate," it would perform both the export and import functions.

title: [Request] New topic from selected messages
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

It is common to encounter a situation when engaging in a multi-round conversation with AI where we want to return to a specific point and start over. At present, the only viable option is to delete all messages following this one to achieve that. However, this is not an efficient or user-friendly solution. I propose the following alternative:

1. Add a feature called "New topic from selected messages".
2. Add an option "New topic from here" in the message context menu.

### 🧐 Proposed Solution

### Add a feature called "New topic from selected messages"

On the chat page, it would be helpful to have an option that allows users to enter the message multiple selection mode. Once in this mode, after the user has selected a message, the context menu should provide a "New topic from selected messages" function. Upon selecting this option, a new topic will be created under the current agent, and the selected messages will be copied into the conversation. If possible, consider adding a delete function as well, so that multiple messages can be deleted at once.

### Add an option "New topic from here" in the message context menu

On the chat page, when a user selects the context menu of a message, include an option to start a new conversation from here. Upon clicking, a new topic will be created under the current agent, including all the messages from the start up to the selected one.

title: [Bug] When editing historical messages (not the last one) in long conversations, page jumps to bottom or below. Need to scroll up to find edited content
body:
### 📦 部署环境

Docker

### 📌 软件版本

1.24.1（服务器版本）

### 💻 系统环境

Ubuntu

### 🌐 浏览器

Edge

### 🐛 问题描述

在多条长对话中编辑历史对话（非最后一条）时，会直接跳到回答底部。此时需要向上翻才能找到编辑的内容。推测是因为总是使用到顶部的距离，而编辑时会限制文本框高度，导致要编辑的内容变矮，而此时与顶端高度相同的地方就变成了底部（或更下面的位置）

### 📷 复现步骤

打开一个会话，添加两条消息，每条消息`"test\n"*200`。然后点击编辑第一条消息，即可复现。

### 🚦 期望结果

每次打开编辑都会定位到输入框顶部

### 📝 补充信息

或许可以参考下面的修改方法？
- 每次打开编辑都定位到上一条消息底部
- 编辑按钮在单条消息顶部，这样就可以避免这个问题
- 能设置编辑框不折叠高度（最好编辑按钮是悬浮的，这样可以翻到哪里修改到哪里
- 菜单栏有一个编辑按钮，按下后所有消息都可以直接编辑

感谢大佬们！

title: [Request] Customizable Shortcut for Deleting Conversations
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

Currently, there is a keyboard shortcut (option + command + backspace) that deletes the entire conversation, which can be accidentally triggered when using shortcuts for deleting words or lines. This can lead to unintended loss of important conversation history.

### 🧐 Proposed Solution

Introduce an option to customize or disable the keyboard shortcut for deleting the entire conversation. This would help prevent accidental deletions and allow users to configure shortcuts according to their preferences.

### 📝 Additional Information

⚠️ It's frustrating that such a critical action is tied to a keyboard shortcut that is too easy to trigger accidentally. Whoever designed this combination didn't consider the potential for accidental activation. 

😠 This shortcut should be much more complex or difficult to invoke to prevent unintended data loss and user frustration. Additionally, there is no confirmation popup when this combination is used, and there is absolutely no way to undo this operation!

title: [Docs] Feedback for `usage/tools-calling`
body:
### 📝 Reference

https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/tree/main/docs/usage/tools-calling.zh-CN.mdx

### 🐛 Feedback

tools-calling除了这个应用外，还有一个应用形式，即「结构化输出」(Structured Output)，如：

```python
from typing import Optional
from pathlib import Path
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI

class Joke(BaseModel):
    '''Joke to tell user.'''
    setup: str = Field(description="The setup of the joke")
    punchline: str = Field(description="The punchline to the joke")
    rating: Optional[int] = Field(description="How funny the joke is, from 1 to 10")


model = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o-mini")
model = model.with_structured_output(Joke)
prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    ("system", "你是一个幽默大师"),
    ("user", "{text}")
])
```

在LangSmith中可以看到返回后会调用`PydanticToolParser`，从而确保了语言模型的输出符合指定结构。

在具体实现上，呼叫API的时候，tools中会给出指定类的schema，模型就会严格按照这个schema返回信息。

此外，我还发现一个好像很多模型都会忽视的一个问题，就是当提供的上下文，如`{text}`的内容过长时，许多模型的tool_calls就会失败。比如当提供了4K内容给`{text}`的时候，许多模型就开始忽略tool_calls的调用，转为普通的输出了。因此测试的时候，可以考虑增加指令、上下文长度和tool_calls的成功率的测试。

title: [Request] 角色设定 Prompt  支持指定Message Role 并支持多条初始Message
body: ### 🥰 需求描述 目前lobe-chat助手的角色设定 prompt 设置只支持单条文本，如图 而实际目前大部分的模型API的 请求参数是一个类似的Message 列表 ``` [ { "role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant." }, { "role": "user", "content": "Hello!" } ] ``` 基于模型API 的能力，我们可以通过填充多个Message 达到利用模型本身消息结构的few-shot的效果，而不是把所有提示都放到system 或第一次的user 消息中，以达到更好的fewshot 效果 ### 🧐 解决方案 角色设定支持类似如下模式的输入： 对于现有的模版，按照当前请求LLM API 的传参设定，补充默认role 信息或增加高级模式来实现 ### 📝 补充信息 参考 ChatGPT-Next-Web 项目的设计，这项功能深受用户喜欢 https://github.com/ChatGPTNextWeb/ChatGPT-Next-Web/issues/138

title: [Request] Does not seem to support Ollama's llama3.2-vision images
body:
### 🥰 需求描述

Ollama 0.4.0 支持了 llama3.2-vision 模型，可以识别图片。https://ollama.com/blog/llama3.2-vision

目前尝试了在 LobeChat v1.28.4 中调用了 llama3.2-vision 模型，发现不能正确处理图片。

从日志可以看到相关请求体：

```json
{
  "messages": [
    {
      "content": "图片上有什么文字\n\n<files_info>\n<images>\n<images_docstring>here are user upload images you can refer to</images_docstring>\n<image name=\"deval.png\" url=\"https://s3-lobechat.tabun.pro/files/480844/8b97987b-0e33-4a02-9fbc-f03dc34e0567.png\"></image>\n</images>\n\n</files_info>",
      "role": "user"
    }
  ],
  "model": "llama3.2-vision",
  "options": {
    "frequency_penalty": 0,
    "presence_penalty": 0,
    "temperature": 0.35,
    "top_p": 1
  },
  "stream": true
}
```

看起来是把图片放在 content 中了，ollama 的 llama3.2-vision 模型的支持方式可能不同。

希望能够支持一下，谢谢🙏！

### 🧐 解决方案

从 ollama 的文档看，应该是类似以下的格式：

```
curl http://localhost:11434/api/chat -d '{
  "model": "llama3.2-vision",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "what is in this image?",
      "images": ["<base64-encoded image data>"]
    }
  ]
}'
```

既图片需要 base64 encode 之后放在 images 中，而且是一个数组。

### 📝 补充信息

_No response_

title: [Request] Timestamp and Force Import Duplicate
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

Hello, when we are importing the backup, please add a timestamp.

Also when we export the settings from non server version, and import in server version, then all the duplicate agents are ignored. But sometimes we just update the category, or update the role settings, those are not getting updated, as it's skipped by default.


### 🧐 Proposed Solution

When we import the settings, it should say "duplicates" found, Force Import or Ignore it. If we click on force import, then it will update all the agents.

Also there should be an option, only keep the new importent agents, and group settings, and remove anything which is not in the import file, and then yes.


### 📝 Additional Information

Because we are always keep updating the agents. If it gets skipped, then we have to manually update again on server version.

And why server version don't have an export all settings function?

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

1. Add a new Assistant.
2. In the new chat interface, click the Edit button in the Role Setting at the top right corner.
3. Modify the content and click OK. The content appears to be updated.
4. Click the Edit button again and notice that the input box is empty and has not updated. (If there was a value in the Role Setting before modification, the input box will show the previous value instead of the new one after clicking Edit.)

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

I expected the input box to show the updated content after editing the Role Setting a second time.This will be helpful for people who want to Modify the Role Setting again after click OK.

### 📝 Additional Information

I have noticed that the issue is caused by the implementation in the lobe-ui component. The `EditableMessage` component internally specifies `defaultValue` to create a `MessageInput` component, but in the `MessageInput` component, `defaultValue` is handled as follows:

```typescript
const [temporaryValue, setValue] = useState<string>(defaultValue || '');
```

This implementation retains the previous value in the input box, making it inconvenient for users to edit again.

### Possible Solutions:

- Modify the lobe-chat main repository by adding a key to the `EditableMessage` component in `/src/app/(main)/chat/(workspace)/@topic/features/SystemRole/SystemRoleContent.tsx` to trigger a re-render (this would cause the Modal to flicker).
- Modify the lobe-ui implementation by adding a listener for changes to `defaultValue` in the `MessageInput` component, but this could make the UI component library unnecessarily complex.

I hope a better solution can be found, and I would be happy to submit a PR.

title: [Request] 对话分支
body:
### 🥰 需求描述

现在可以修改对话中之前的提问，然后重新生成，但此前的提问就找不到了，而且生成的内容并没有覆盖之前AI的回复，而是在之前AI回复之下又生成了新的回复，这会让人比较困惑。

举例：
比如我问AI，xxx的方案。
AI给了两个，我两个都想具体了解，但又不想在一次会话中掺入与最终方案无关的支路对话内容，就会进行分支。
我第一次会说，我想了解A方案，完了我会将“我想了解A方案”修改为：我想了解B方案，然后我自行判断哪个更好，哪个更好，就沿着哪条路走下去，甚至我在A方案中走了10步后，我想想，还是B方案好，我再回到最开始“我想了解A/B方案”那个分支的地方，再沿着B方案走下去。

我知道现在可以对自己的和AI生成的内容进行修改和删除，但是修改了之后，不会覆盖之前的内容，而是在下面生成了新回复，看上去就比较奇怪，而且我也不知道这是不是会带到上下文中去。

还有就是对于修改AI回复的这个功能我持怀疑态度，这样确实很自由，但很多时候，AI行就是行，不行就是不行，如果AI回复的内容中部分不正确，你改对了，但AI本身能力不行，你这里改了，后面该错还是错。 

### 🧐 解决方案

完全仿照Claude，可以左右切换对话分支。（甚至我一直觉得Claude可以针对该特性搞个树状图的可视化出来。）

我是Claude这两天被封了之后开了你们的云版本的会员，这个功能我觉得可以搞成云版本特供。😆

### 📝 补充信息

_No response_

title: [Request] 纯净模式
body:
### 🥰 需求描述

### 🧐 解决方案

搞个快捷键，能一键进入纯净模式，或者叫禅模式🤣🤣隐藏左边右边的内容，还有用户的输入，感觉可以对标Claude，现在的输入我咋调都感觉占了我好多空间😢 ，那些统计信息啥的一排按钮，在这个模式下，都可以不要显示了，或者搞个集成的，鼠标悬浮上去可以看到。

再讲一下之前使用Claude方式，一般是手头有一个主任务，比较长的对话，那么这之间可能会穿插着问一两个无关的小问题，这时候我不会在Claude界面中点击新建会话，我会直接点击浏览器收藏bar中的Claude来新建会话，而且，你会发现，这样一个新建的会话，它的用户输入框是在屏幕中央的，这就很舒服，等开始对话后，它再被放到最下面。

title: [Request] Support for Amazon Cognito as an Authentication Provider
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

We are seeking to integrate Amazon Cognito as an authentication provider in the system. This feature will allow seamless user authentication, enhanced security, and better integration with AWS services.

### 🧐 Proposed Solution

Add support for Amazon Cognito as an authentication provider in the authentication settings. This could include options for configuring Cognito User Pools, Federated Identities, and integration with third-party identity providers supported by Cognito.

### 📝 Additional Information

Amazon Cognito provides robust features such as user management, multi-factor authentication, and compliance with security standards like GDPR and HIPAA. Supporting this feature would benefit users leveraging AWS for their infrastructure, enhancing compatibility and reducing setup complexity.

title: [Request] 个人资料页面
body:
### 🥰 需求描述

Logto最近更新支持Account API了。不知道是否可以实现个人资料页面，方便更改用户名、密码、头像啥的



### 🧐 解决方案

[ref](https://docs.logto.io/docs/recipes/interact-with-account-api/)

What is Logto Account API

The Logto Acount API is a comprehensive set of APIs that gives the end users direct API access without needing to go through the Management API, here is the highlights:

    Direct access: The Account API empowers end users to directly access and manage their own account profile without requiring the relay of Management API.
    User profile and identities management: Users can fully manage their profiles and security settings, including the ability to update identity information like email, phone, and password, as well as manage social connections. MFA and SSO support are coming soon.
    Global access control: Admin has full, global control over access settings, can customize each fields.
    Seamless authorization: Authorizing is easier than ever! Simply use client.getAccessToken() to obtain an opaque access token for OP (Logto), and attach it to the Authorization header as Bearer <access_token>.

With the Logto Account API, you can build a custom account management system like a profile page that is fully integrated with Logto.

Some frequently usage are listed below:

    Retrieve user profile
    Update user profile
    Update user password
    Update user identities including email, phone, and social connections

To learn more about the APIs that are available, please visit [Logto Account API Reference](https://openapi.logto.io/operation/operation-getprofile?_gl=1*1hk3yl5*_gcl_au*Mjk4MTgzNDU4LjE3MzIyODIxNjA.*_ga*MTQyMDk3OTY5OC4xNzMyMjgyMTYw*_ga_THRJP0BLWG*MTczMjI4MjE1OS4xLjEuMTczMjI4Mjk3NS4wLjAuMA..) and [Logto Verification API Reference](https://openapi.logto.io/operation/operation-createverificationbypassword).

title: [Request] Option to simplify Interface
body: ### 🥰 Feature Description The current start page of LobeChat contains numerous visual elements including multiple emojis, assistant recommendations, and FAQ sections that can be distracting for users who prefer a minimal interface. While these features may be helpful for new users, they can create visual noise for those who want to focus solely on their conversation with the AI assistant. ### 🧐 Proposed Solution - Add a toggle in settings to enable a "Minimal Mode" for the start page - In Minimal Mode: - Remove or reduce the number of emojis - Hide the assistant recommendations section - Collapse the FAQ section into a menu - Keep only essential elements like the chat input and basic navigation - Allow users to customize which elements they want to show/hide ### 📝 Additional Information This feature would improve the user experience for those who prefer a cleaner, more focused interface while maintaining the full functionality for users who enjoy the current layout

title: [Request] NextAuth Credentials provider
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

I'm using LobeChat self-hosted and want to migrate to the server mode. However, I don't want to use an external identity provider (Github, Google, etc) and don't want to set up my own (Casdoor). I don't really need multi-user features at all. Ideally, I'd like to hard-code a username and password using environment variables.

### 🧐 Proposed Solution

[NextAuth.js Credentials Provider](https://next-auth.js.org/providers/credentials) can be used to enable a single-user, server-mode install. It could be configured using environment variables:

```
NEXT_AUTH_SSO_PROVIDERS=credentials
AUTH_CREDENTIALS_USERNAME=email@example.com
AUTH_CREDENTIALS_PASSWORD=password
```

body:
### 📦 Environment

Vercel

### 📌 Version

v1.35.4

### 💻 Operating System

Other Linux

### 🌐 Browser

Firefox

### 🐛 Bug Description

When prompting a difficult question (i.e. a question that uses a noticeably time before response) using OpenAI o1-mini, the response does not return but instead an error: 

```json
{
  "name": "TypeError",
  "stack": "",
  "message": "NetworkError when attempting to fetch resource."
}
```

This issue can currently be bypassed through generating another API key, pasting it into the local model configuration and turn on `Use Client-Side Fetching Mode`, but still annoying nonetheless. 

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

Paste the OpenAI API key into the Vercel environment variable and remember to remove your local API key. 

Give the model a difficult question, such as a "Hard" level competitive programming question from any website, and it'll naturally appear.

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

It should be able to response after thinking for that long, instead of returning a `TypeError` when attempting to receive the answer. 

### 📝 Additional Information

My Vercel deployment has been fully configured using the instruction shown in the [LobeChat Advanced Deployment with Vercel documentation](https://lobehub.com/docs/self-hosting/server-database/vercel), i.e. all the needed model API keys put inside the Vercel environment variables (I have also disabled other models as well using `-all`), a Neon serverless Postgres database from Vercel as the database, Clerk as the authentication service, and Cloudflare R2 as S3 storage service.

title: [Request]  Configuration for Mandatory and Optional Plugins in Agents
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

It would be great to have the ability to define which plugins are mandatory and which are optional directly in the agent configuration (manifest). This would allow agents to have pre-configured plugins enabled by default, ensuring they have all the necessary tools for proper functionality while maintaining the flexibility to enhance their capabilities with optional plugins.

Currently, there is no straightforward way to specify this distinction, requiring manual setup every time an agent is created or modified.

### 🧐 Proposed Solution

A possible solution could be to introduce a new plugin_configuration key within the agent's configuration (e.g., under the config section in the agent manifest). This key could specify:

Mandatory Plugins: Essential plugins required for the agent to function correctly. These plugins would always be loaded.
Optional Plugins: Non-essential plugins that enhance the agent's functionality. These plugins would load if available but would not block the agent if missing.

### 📝 Additional Information

```json
{
  "author": "your name or org name",
  "config": {
    "displayMode": "chat or docs",
    "systemRole": "agent prompt",
    "model": "gpt-4",
    "plugins": {
       "optionals": [...],
       "required": [...]
    }
    "params": {
      "frequency_penalty": 0,
      "presence_penalty": 0,
      "temperature": 0.6,
      "top_p": 1
    },
    [....]
}
```

This feature would reduce operational overhead by ensuring essential plugins are automatically set up for agents.

title: High CPU Usage of Lobechat
body:
I have observed abnormally high CPU utilization in LobeChat across both the Progressive Web App (PWA) and conventional web browser versions. Through investigation, I found that: - The issue persists regardless of the access method (PWA or web browser) - The high CPU usage occurs even with a clean chat session without user login - Chat history is not the root cause, as the problem manifests in completely new sessions Based on these observations, the excessive CPU usage may be related to the UI rendering implementation. My Machine is MacBook Pro (M4 pro chip) model. OS: MacOS 15.1.1 ⬇️ After opening the webpage, CPU usage of `Safari Graphics and Media` increases immediately. ⬇️Just opening a New clean page will cause this issue. ### Discussed in https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/4784
Originally posted by **ChenglongWang** November 25, 2024 Hi, I am currently using the Progressive Web App (PWA) version of Lobechat for my daily usage. However, I've noticed that the CPU usage for the Lobechat client is significantly higher compared to other applications, which also caused high battery usage. Is there a way to address this issue and reduce the CPU consumption? Any recommendations or tips would be greatly appreciated. Machine: MacBook Pro M4 Thank you!

### 📷 复现步骤

1. 使用命令新建服务 `bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/HEAD/docker-compose/local/setup.sh) -f -l zh_CN`
2. docker compose up -d 启动服务
3. http://localhost:8000 访问 casdoor 使用 admin 登录后新建组织，名称为 chat
4. casdoor  新建应用
	- 名称为 chat，组织选 chat
	- 注册项中关闭电子邮箱、手机号选项
	- callback url 填入 http://localhost:3210/api/auth/callback/casdoor
	- 复制客户端ID 和 客户端密钥
5. docker compose down 停止服务
6. 修改 .env 文件中的 AUTH_CASDOOR_ID 和 AUTH_CASDOOR_SECRET 为上面复制的
7. docker compose up -d 启动服务
8. http://localhost:3210 访问 lobechat，选择 登录/注册，跳转 casdoor 后注册 user1，接着以 user1 身份登录 lobechat，此时 lobechat 显示登录用户为 user1
9. 退出登录 user1，选择 登录/注册，跳转 casdoor 后注册 user2，接着以 user2 身份登录 lobechat，此时 lobechat 显示登录用户为仍然 user1
10. 退出登录继续注册登录其他用户，登录后显示的依然是 user1

### 🚦 期望结果

使用 Casdoor 登录后，LobeChat 登录正确的用户

Casdoor 版本为 v1.762.0

title: Pglite Client DB Feedback | 客户端 Pglite DB 功能反馈
body:
Looking to the future, LobeChat introduces a brand new Client DB engine in v1.37.0: [PGlite](https://pglite.dev/). It is the wasm version of our server-side database Postgres, capable of running in the browser with a relatively small footprint while providing database capabilities that are fully consistent with Postgres, which means:

- In a pure client, we will have complete knowledge base dialogue capabilities (pglite supports core vector retrieval functions);
- Due to the complete consistency of the schema between the two ends of the db, capabilities that were previously only available in the server-side db will subsequently be fully available on the client side as well. (branch conversations is available in 1.38.0);
The implementation of the database on both the client and server sides will only need to be done once, significantly reducing future development costs, and most features will be able to be updated synchronously to both the client and server versions in the future;
With the help of a CRDT collaboration engine like [electric-sql](https://electric-sql.com/), we will be able to truly integrate a unified client/server in the future, achieving a local-first, on-demand synchronization ultimate form.
- In the future, we may even achieve multi-person online collaborative AI conversations through group chats!

However, any forward-looking innovation comes at a cost. While we are very optimistic about the potential of PGlite, it is still a very early project at this point in time, and there are currently no large-scale user projects that are truly using it in production scenarios. As a pioneering explorer of open-source AI projects, LobeChat hopes to explore the possibilities of using PGlite together with the community and to discover new best practices for applications in the AI era!

#### How to use

This change has no impact on users using the server-side DB.


To avoid affecting the existing client DB users, we have added a new environment variable to enable pglite. You can enable the use of pglite by adding `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLIENT_DB=pglite` during the application build.

> \[!IMPORTANT]
> Note: Currently, automatic data migration has not been implemented. Please manually back up the existing data before adding variables.


We will enable this engine by default in the major version of LobeChat V2 and remove all existing implementations of dexie.

--------

面向未来，LobeChat 在 v1.37.0 中提供了一种全新的 Client DB 引擎： [PGlite](https://pglite.dev/)。它是我们服务端数据库 Postgres 的 wasm 版本，可以以相对较小的体积在浏览器中运行，并获得与 Postgres 完全一致的数据库能力，这意味着：

- 在纯客户端中，我们将可以拥有完整的知识库对话能力（pglite 支持核心的向量检索功能）；
- 由于两端 db 的schema 做到了完全一致，之前只有在服务端 db 中才可用的能力，后续将在客户端中也完全可用。（1.38.0 已支持分支对话）；
- 客户端和服务端的 db 实现将只需做一次，大大降低了未来的研发成本，未来大部分特性将能同步更新到客户端与服务端版本中；
- 借助 [electric-sql](https://electric-sql.com/) 这样的 CRDT 协同引擎，我们将可以在后续真正融合统一客户端/服务端，实现本地优先，按需同步的终极形态。
- 甚至，在未来我们可以通过群聊中实现多人在线协同的 ai 对话！

但是，任何面向未来的创新都是有代价的，虽然我们非常看好 PGlite 的潜力，但 PGlite 在当前的时间点下仍然是一个非常早期的项目，目前也没有一个大规模用户的项目真正在生产场景下使用它。而 LobeChat 作为开源 AI 项目的先锋探索者，我们希望与社区一起探索使用 PGlite 的可能性，一起来探索 AI 时代新的应用最佳实践！

#### 如何使用

> 本次变更对于使用服务端 DB 的用户来说没有任何影响。


为了不影响原有客户端 DB 用户的使用，我们新增了一个环境变量用于启用 pglite。

【Vercel/Zeabur 等部署环境】

你可以通过在应用构建时添加  `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLIENT_DB=pglite` 来开启 pglite 的使用。

【Docker】

提供 [lobe-chat-pglite](https://hub.docker.com/r/lobehub/lobe-chat-pglite) 镜像，供感兴趣的用户提前尝鲜。

- https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/pull/6287

**注意：该镜像会在 V2 正式发布后被废弃，届时需要重新迁移回 lobe-chat** 镜像

> \[!IMPORTANT]
> 注意事项：目前没有实现数据的自动迁移，请在添加变量前手动备份原有的数据。


我们将会在 LobeChat V2 大版本中默认开启该引擎，并移除原有的 dexie 的所有实现。

  const enableHistoryDivider = useAgentStore((s) => {

user: A
AI：B

title: [Request] Add ability to send PDF/files without embedings
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

Modern models such as claude/gpt4o/o1 have perfect native support for PDF and some other file formats. But Lobe currently works with such files only via RAG/embeddings, which is not optimal for those models

### 🧐 Proposed Solution

Add ability to send files directly to models, without any embeddings processing.

### 📝 Additional Information

This is claude's PDF API guide, just as example: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/pdf-support

title: [Bug] Document/Conversation Mode Switch Not Functional in Just Chat Agent (Database Version)
body:
### 📦 Environment

Docker

### 📌 Version

v1.40.3

### 💻 Operating System

Other Linux

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome, Firefox

### 🐛 Bug Description

**Summary:**
The mode switch between "Document Mode" and "Conversation Mode" within the "Just Chat" assistant is not functioning correctly in the database version of LobeChat. The UI does not reflect changes when toggling between these modes, and the behavior of the agent remains consistent regardless of the selected mode. This issue does not occur in the client-side database mode.

**Environment:**

*   **LobeChat Version:** (Please fill this in if available, e.g., latest, a specific release tag)
*   **Deployment:** Database version, deployed using Docker Compose.
*   **Database:** PostgreSQL (pgvector/pgvector:pg16).
*   **.env Configurations:** As provided in the original report (see details below).
*   **docker-compose.yml:** As provided in the original report (see details below).

**Additional Notes:**

*   This issue is **not** reproducible in the client-side database mode.
*   There are no errors observed in the LobeChat container logs or PostgreSQL logs concerning this issue.
*   No log records related to the mode switching action are generated in the container logs when the switch is used.
*    The `.env` file is correctly configured as all basic functions are usable.

**Relevant Configurations:**

Here's the provided `.env` configuration:

```
# 必填，LobeChat 域名，用于 tRPC 调用

APP_URL=https://lobe.example.com/

# Postgres 相关，也即 DB 必需的环境变量
# 必填，用于加密敏感信息的密钥，可以使用 openssl rand -base64 32 生成
KEY_VAULTS_SECRET='YOUR_KEY_VAULTS_SECRET' # 需要替换为你生成的 KEY_VAULTS_SECRET 密钥
# 必填，Postgres 数据库连接字符串，用于连接到数据库
# 格式：postgresql://username:password@host:port/dbname，如果你的 pg 实例为 Docker 容器且位于同一 docker-compose 文件中，亦可使用容器名作为 host
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:YOUR_POSTGRES_PASSWORD@postgresql:5432/lobe  # 需要替换为你实际的 PostgreSQL 数据库密码

# NEXT_AUTH 相关，也即鉴权服务必需的环境变量
# 可以使用 auth0、Azure AD、GitHub、Authentik、Zitadel、Logto 等，如有其他接入诉求欢迎提 PR
# 目前支持的鉴权服务提供商请参考：https://lobehub.com/zh/docs/self-hosting/advanced/auth#next-auth
# 如果你有 ACCESS_CODE，请务必清空，我们以 NEXT_AUTH 作为唯一鉴权来源
# 必填，用于 NextAuth 的密钥，可以使用 openssl rand -base64 32 生成
NEXT_AUTH_SECRET='YOUR_NEXT_AUTH_SECRET' # 需要替换为你生成的 NEXT_AUTH_SECRET 密钥
# 必填，指定鉴权服务提供商，这里以 GitHub 为例
NEXT_AUTH_SSO_PROVIDERS=github
# 必填，NextAuth 的 URL，用于 NextAuth 的回调
NEXTAUTH_URL=https://lobe.example.com

# NextAuth 鉴权服务提供商部分，以 GitHub 为例

AUTH_GITHUB_ID=YOUR_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID # 需要替换为你 GitHub OAuth 应用的 Client ID
AUTH_GITHUB_SECRET=YOUR_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET # 需要替换为你 GitHub OAuth 应用的 Client Secret

# 代理相关，如果你需要的话（比如你使用 GitHub 作为鉴权服务提供商）

# 必填，S3 的 Public Domain，用于客户端通过公开连接访问非结构化数据
S3_PUBLIC_DOMAIN=https://r2-lobe.example.com
# 请替换为实际的 Public Domain，如果没有可以留空

# 选填，S3 的 Enable Path Style。对于 Cloudflare R2, 设置为 0
S3_ENABLE_PATH_STYLE=0
```

```
name: lobe-chat-database
services:
  postgresql:
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16
    container_name: lobe-postgres
    ports:
      - '5432:5432'
    volumes:
      - './data:/var/lib/postgresql/data'
    environment:
      - 'POSTGRES_DB=lobe'
      - 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=YOUR_POSTGRES_PASSWORD' # 需要替换为你的 PostgreSQL 数据库密码
    healthcheck:

### 🥰 需求描述

使用场景：
1、大部分会话不需要前置历史对话，附带历史消息会影响模型生成效果，并浪费大量Token。
2、有的时候又需要历史对话，现在Lobe的设计不能很好的支持两种模式的切换

问题1：如果要清除上下文，必须新建会话或清空整个会话，这样会导致出现大量的会话或者历史消息丢失。
问题2：如果想使用历史消息数临时调整范围，每次必须手工选择数字，操作很不方便。

### 🧐 解决方案

希望提供一个类似NextChat的清除聊天功能

### 📦 部署环境

### 📷 复现步骤

上传图片

### 🚦 期望结果

成功上传

### 📝 补充信息

这里附上我的docker-compose和.env

docker-compose.yml:
```
services:
  network-service:
    image: alpine
    container_name: lobe-network
    ports:
      - '${MINIO_PORT}:${MINIO_PORT}' # MinIO API
      - '9001:9001' # MinIO Console
      - '${CASDOOR_PORT}:${CASDOOR_PORT}' # Casdoor
      - '${LOBE_PORT}:3210' # LobeChat
    command: tail -f /dev/null
    networks:
      - lobe-network

  postgresql:
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16
    container_name: lobe-postgres
    ports:
      - '5432:5432'
    volumes:
      - './data:/var/lib/postgresql/data'
    environment:
      - 'POSTGRES_DB=${LOBE_DB_NAME}'
      - 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}'
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U postgres']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: always
    networks:
      - lobe-network

  minio:
    image: minio/minio
    container_name: lobe-minio
    network_mode: 'service:network-service'
    volumes:
      - './s3_data:/etc/minio/data'
    environment:
      - 'MINIO_ROOT_USER=${MINIO_ROOT_USER}'
      - 'MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=${MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MINIO_API_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN=https://lobe.[mydomain:myport]'
    restart: always
    command: >
      server /etc/minio/data --address ":${MINIO_PORT}" --console-address ":9001"


  casdoor:
    image: casbin/casdoor
    container_name: lobe-casdoor
    entrypoint: /bin/sh -c './server --createDatabase=true'
    network_mode: 'service:network-service'
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      RUNNING_IN_DOCKER: 'true'
      driverName: 'postgres'
      dataSourceName: 'user=postgres password=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD} host=postgresql port=5432 sslmode=disable dbname=casdoor'
      origin: 'https://lobe-auth-api.[mydomain:myport]'
      runmode: 'dev'
        #volumes:
        #- ./init_data.json:/init_data.json

  lobe:
    image: lobehub/lobe-chat-database
    container_name: lobe-chat
    network_mode: 'service:network-service'
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy
      network-service:
        condition: service_started
      minio:
        condition: service_started
      casdoor:
        condition: service_started

    environment:
      - 'APP_URL=https://lobe.[mydomain:myport]'
      - 'NEXT_AUTH_SSO_PROVIDERS=casdoor'
      - 'KEY_VAULTS_SECRET=[MYSECRET]'
      - 'NEXT_AUTH_SECRET=[MYSECRET]'
      - 'AUTH_URL=https://lobe.[mydomain:myport]/api/auth'
      - 'AUTH_CASDOOR_ISSUER=https://lobe-auth-api.[mydomain:myport]'
      - 'DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgresql:5432/${LOBE_DB_NAME}'
      - 'S3_ENDPOINT=https://lobe-s3-api.[mydomain:myport]'
      - 'S3_BUCKET=${MINIO_LOBE_BUCKET}'
      - 'S3_PUBLIC_DOMAIN=http://lobe-s3-api.[mydomain:myport]'
      - 'S3_ENABLE_PATH_STYLE=1'
      - 'LLM_VISION_IMAGE_USE_BASE64=1'
    env_file:
      - .env
    restart: always

volumes:
  data:
    driver: local
  s3_data:
    driver: local

networks:
  lobe-network:
    driver: bridge

title: Brand new AI provider Feedback | 全新 AI Provider 管理模块反馈
body: We released a brand new AI Provider management module in version v1.44.0, bringing a completely new experience for managing AI service providers. Based on extensive user feedback, we introduced the following in this new Provider version: - Create custom service providers (supporting different SDK formats, such as multiple OpenAI format providers), create custom models; - Capabilities and parameter customization for all models (currently only FC and Vision are available, more will be opened in the future based on community demand); - Custom sorting by service provider, enable custom sorting of models; - Supported full-type models at the framework level (language models, embedding models, TTS/STT models, text-to-image models). This framework enables us to support richer modal AI models in the future, such as text-to-video and music models. As the new feature for the beginning of 2025, we expect this new module to encompass all possibilities for the coming year, making LobeChat the most versatile client in the AI Chat field~ > \[!IMPORTANT] > Note: This AI Provider module upgrade is only available under the server DB. Future iterations will support pglite mode. The dexie db will maintain its original implementation and will be completely removed in v2.0. At the same time, the AI Provider page has undergone a complete rewrite from data storage to front-end implementation in order to achieve better performance and interaction experience. Therefore, at this stage, the logic related to the original **environment variables** may not be implemented or may have flaws. If you encounter any scenarios that do not meet your expectations, please provide feedback below, and I will strive to complete the fix within T+1 days. Therefore, when this post is closed, if there are still no feedback on the environment variable issue, it will be removed as a deprecated feature in V2. ------- 我们在 v1.44.0 版本发布了全新的 AI Provider 管理模块，带来了全新的 AI 服务商管理体验。结合诸多用户反馈，我们在这一全新的 Provider 版本中，带来了： - [x] 创建自定义服务商（支持不同 SDK 格式，例如多个 OpenAI 格式的服务商）、创建自定义模型； - [x] 所有模型的能力、参数自定义（目前仅开放 `FC` 和 `Vision`，未来将会根据社区诉求开放更多参数，例如模型是否支持流式等）； - [x] 服务商自定义排序、启用模型的自定义排序； - [x] 在框架层支持了全量类型的模型（语言模型、Embedding模型、TTS/STT 模型、文生图模型。这一框架使得我们未来也将能支持上文生视频、音乐模型等更丰富模态的 AI 模型。 ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3f8328ac-4947-451e-a707-23c826723ffb) > \[!IMPORTANT] > 注意事项：本次 AI Provider 模块升级，只在服务端 DB 与 pglite 模式下可用。而 dexie db 仍保持原有实现，后续将在 v2.0 中完全移除。 由于AI Provider 这个页面从数据存储到前端实现是一次完全的重写，以期获得更好的操作性能和交互体验。因此数据上是完全独立的两套，我们不做任何迁移，升级后你需要自行重新配置对应的 Provider。同时现阶段的实现中，和原有 **环境变量** 相关的部分的逻辑可能没有实现或者存在瑕疵。如果遇到不符合你的预期场景，请在下方反馈，我会争取在当天评估是否对齐原有逻辑，如需对齐， T+1 天内完成对齐。 待本帖关闭时，如果仍然没有反馈的环境变量问题，也将作为废弃功能在 V2 中移除。 作为 2025 年的开年新特性，我们期望这个新的模块能承载未来一年的全部可能性，让 LobeChat 变成 AI Chat 领域最全面的 AI 客户端 🚀

body:
### 🥰 需求描述

有没有办法能够定期同步知识库？
想象一个场景，因为我们的笔记本身肯定是写在笔记软件里的，假设 notion 这样的个人笔记/知识库，我想要定期把它的 markdown 内容同步到 lobechat 的知识库，并进行分块，但是不想周期性的手动进行这个操作。

body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

I want to create a code interpreter plugin, but the model's default output shares the previous code context, so I need a dialogue retention system. However, the plugin API does not have a field to indicate that the request comes from a conversation.

### 🧐 Proposed Solution

When the gateway requests the plugin API, it carries an X-Session-Id parameter in the header by default, indicating the dialogue ID.

### 📝 Additional Information

When I have time, I might submit a PR to implement it. I really like Lobechat, and I am eager to create a code interpreter that connects to my operation and maintenance system to assist with some cluster SRE work.

title: [Bug] Sub-conversation context expansion issue
body:
### 📦 部署环境

Docker

### 📌 软件版本

v1.45.0

### 💻 系统环境

Windows

### 🌐 浏览器

Chrome

### 🐛 问题描述

在进入子对话聊天窗口后, 上文(之前的消息)中的子对话被全部展开, 并且均只展开到第一层子对话中的消息.

创建子对话时勾选`保留/不保留上下文`**均会**触发此行为.

### 📷 复现步骤

## 设置测试上下文场景
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/705a72f4-edd0-4231-aae4-5da0ea2eb551)

## 子话题1-2拥有两条消息
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e05c0188-cac2-483f-9a13-514386af23f4)

## 进入子话题3-1时发现:
- 子话题1-x, 2-x均被展开
- 子话题1-2的多条消息只展开到第一层(子消息1-2-1)

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5cf55209-56cd-4fd0-a359-7ef6eea529dc)



### 🚦 期望结果

个人认为子对话的上下文不适合包含前文中子对话的内容, 子对话的唯一上下文应该只有主对话分支中的历史内容.

如果设计逻辑使得子对话上下文包含前文子对话内容, 那么无法确定仅展开至第一层消息的行为是否为Bug.

### 📝 补充信息

不是很确定该行为是否为正常设计的逻辑, 辛苦作者检查一下💕

title: [Request] 希望支持deepseek新模型deepseek-r1的api接口
body:
### 🥰 需求描述

目前问题：
向api请求时返回
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_request_error",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": null,
    "message": "deepseek-reasoner does not support the parameter `presence_penalty`"
  },
  "endpoint": "https://api.deepseek.com/v1",
  "provider": "deepseek"
}


### 🧐 解决方案

可能是由于lobe请求自带presence_penalty等参数导致，删除后应该就可以了。

temperature、top_p、presence_penalty、frequency_penalty、logprobs、top_logprobs都不可以存在。

官方文档显示：

> API 参数
> 
>     输入参数：
>         max_tokens：最终回答的最大长度（不含思维链输出），默认为 4K，最大为 8K。请注意，思维链的输出最多可以达到 32K tokens，控思维链的长度的参数（reasoning_effort）将会在近期上线。
> 
>     输出字段：
>         reasoning_content：思维链内容，与 content 同级，访问方法见[访问样例](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/reasoning_model#%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%E6%A0%B7%E4%BE%8B)
>         content：最终回答内容
> 
>     上下文长度：API 最大支持 64K 上下文，输出的 reasoning_content 长度不计入 64K 上下文长度中
> 
>     支持的功能：[对话补全](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/api/create-chat-completion)，[对话前缀续写 (Beta)](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/chat_prefix_completion)
> 
>     不支持的功能：Function Call、Json Output、FIM 补全 (Beta)
> 
>     不支持的参数：temperature、top_p、presence_penalty、frequency_penalty、logprobs、top_logprobs

### 📝 补充信息

无

title: [Request] 请求兼容 DeepSeek-R1 模型参数
body:
### 🥰 需求描述

近日 DeepSeek 推出了新的大模型 **R1** [推理模型 (deepseek-reasoner)](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/reasoning_model)

但是官方并不支持某些参数：

>不支持的参数：temperature、top_p、presence_penalty、frequency_penalty、logprobs、top_logprobs

目前看来 LobeChat 请求的时候会默认附带 **presence_penalty** 参数导致请求报错
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_request_error",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": null,
    "message": "deepseek-reasoner does not support the parameter `presence_penalty`"
  },
  "endpoint": "https://api.deepseek.com/v1",
  "provider": "deepseek"
}
```
能否对该模型进行特殊的兼容性处理？

如果可以的话，能否顺便接入 max_tokens 以及思维链参数？

>max_tokens：最终回答的最大长度（不含思维链输出），默认为 4K，最大为 8K。请注意，思维链的输出最多可以达到 32K tokens，控思维链的长度的参数（reasoning_effort）将会在近期上线。


### 🧐 解决方案

对该模型的请求参数进行特殊兼容处理。

title: [Bug] Large messages sent to `o1-preview` are flagged as violating the usage policy
body: ### 📦 Environment Vercel ### 📌 Version v1.47.15 ### 💻 Operating System macOS ### 🌐 Browser Firefox ### 🐛 Bug Description Hello, I've been using lobe-chat since April, 2024, and it's amazing, thank you very much for all the work you've put into it. When `o1-preview` came out in in September, 2024, I noticed an issue with using it via lobe-chat. I discovered the messages over a certain length were rejected by OpenAI as violating their usage policy. Here's a screenshot of this problem in action. ``` { "message": "Invalid prompt: your prompt was flagged as potentially violating our usage policy. Please try again with a different prompt: https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/reasoning#advice-on-prompting", "provider": "openai", "errorType": "ProviderBizError" } ``` Sorry, I don't know exactly how many tokens long my message needs to be to trigger this problem. Somewhere in the 2.5k-5k range I think. I have a workaround, [a personal CLI](https://github.com/johnnymo87/openai-ruby-client) for sending one-shot messages to `o1-preview`, which relies on [the `ruby-openai` gem](https://github.com/alexrudall/ruby-openai) to do the heavy lifting. So when I hit this problem in lobe-chat, I switch to that CLI instead. So I know that there's no actual usage policy violation occurring, because `o1-preview` will respond if I send my message this way. And I don't notice any discussion of this problem in the `ruby-openai` gem's GitHub issues. I wanted to raise this issue here, in case other people have noticed it. ### 📷 Recurrence Steps 1. Get a certain number of tokens by downloading the complete works of Shakespeare and then copying the first 500 lines (yields ~5.5k tokens) to your clipboard (assumes macOS). ``` wget https://ocw.mit.edu/ans7870/6/6.006/s08/lecturenotes/files/t8.shakespeare.txt head -n 500 t8.shakespeare.txt | pbcopy ``` 2. Paste into a new chat with `o1-preview`, send the message. ### 🚦 Expected Behavior I would `o1-preview` to accept lobe-chat messages if it accepts them from my personal CLI. ### 📝 Additional Information Details about my lobe-chat instance. * It is deployed to vercel, with postgresql, S3, and clerk. * It is "server-side", i.e. the requests to AI service providers don't happen in the browser. Instead, it happens on the server. * I vaguely recall that things are different between calling from the browser versus the server. Because prior to upgrading to the server-side calls, my browser-based calls to `o1-preview` would time out. Details about my `o1-preview` assistant. * Message threshold: 2. * Limit History Message Count: disabled.

body:
### 🥰 需求描述

请求添加自定义Embedding中 硅基流动/siliconflow 的选项
硅基流动有BAAI/bge-m3的嵌入模型，但是自定义Embedding不支持硅基流动，希望能支持一下

### 🧐 解决方案

提供适配

### 📝 补充信息

2025-04-03 此问题已解决
具体解决方案，在lobe的Docker-compose中引入如下片段：
```
 lobe:
    image: lobehub/lobe-chat-database
    container_name: lobe-chat
    [中间文字省略]
    environment:
      - 'SILICONCLOUD_API_KEY=YOUR-API-KEY'
      - 'DEFAULT_FILES_CONFIG=embedding_model=siliconcloud/BAAI/bge-m3'
      - 'SILICONCLOUD_PROXY_URL=https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1'
```
以上可以正常工作

title: [Bug] Model Reasoning Timeout and Process Absence
body:
### 📦 部署环境

Vercel

### 📌 软件版本

latest

### 💻 系统环境

Windows

### 🌐 浏览器

Edge

### 🐛 问题描述

深度推理模型(如gemini 2.0 flash thingking, o1等模型)在面对复杂问题(数学题)思考较长时间时，不像deepseek-r1那样展示推理过程。并且会因为推理时间较长(大约1分钟以上)而返回错误“没有收到服务器响应”。在openai或gemini官网使用这些模型时能看到推理过程。

Deep reasoning models (such as Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking, o1, etc) do not show their reasoning process when tackling complex problems (like math questions) and thinking for extended periods, unlike DeepSeek-R1. Often, due to long processing times (around a minute or more), they will return an error such as "No server response received." However, the reasoning process is visible when using these models on the OpenAI or Gemini official websites.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/636c1054-56ec-4e31-ad03-472f49be9e0d)
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6ae82fc5-220a-439d-a552-39ada01b04e9)

### 📷 复现步骤

测试的问题为中国2025年研究生入学考试的一道数学题，经过测试gemini 2.0 flash thinking回答这道题需要1-2分钟，o1与deepseek r1需要十分钟以上甚至思考时间超时(哪怕在官网)。

The test question was a math problem from China's 2025 postgraduate entrance exam. In testing, Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking took 1-2 minutes to answer, while o1 and DeepSeek-R1 required over ten minutes, often timing out even on the official websites.

```
设 $\Sigma$ 是由直线
\begin{equation}
		\begin{cases}
			x = 0 \\
			y = 0
		\end{cases}
\end{equation}
绕直线
\begin{equation}
\begin{cases}
	x = t \\
	y = t \\
	z = t 
\end{cases}
\end{equation}
(t为参数), 旋转一周得到的曲面,$\Sigma_1$ 是 $\Sigma$ 介于平面 $x+y+z=0$ 与 $x+y+z=1$ 之间部分的外侧,计算曲面积分
\begin{equation}
	\iint_{\Sigma_1} x \, dy \, dz + (y+1) \, dz \, dx + (z+2) \, dx \, dy  .
\end{equation}
```

### 🚦 期望结果

希望支持展示更多深度推理模型的推理过程，即使不展示其思考过程也延长从服务器的等待时间。

We hope to see support for displaying the reasoning process of more deep reasoning models. Even if the full thinking process isn't shown, please extend the server timeout period. 

### 📝 补充信息

_No response_

title: [Bug] Forking Breaks If Over 150k Tokens
body:
You can reproduce this bug easily with Claude if your original chat is over 150k tokens and then you fork it. In the fork, as you approach 170k and 180k tokens, every message you send will fail because it says that the 200k token limit has been reached. For some reason, the token counting is inaccurate in the fork.

To get around it, I have to delete the fail message and press retry — then it will work. Every single time I have to send a message in the fork I have to delete the error reply message and then retry which is incredibly annoying and slows me down. It would be great if the forking feature was fixed.

If you have any questions please let me know.

### 🥰 需求描述

目前管理发送给ai的上下文的最高效方式是子话题和创建副本。如果在一个对话中想要防止某条消息被作为上下文发送给api，一个方法是找到其上一条用户消息点击那个位置的重新生成，这条用户消息之后的所有消息都不会作为上下文被发送。如果点击ai回应处的重新生成而不是重新生成并删除，似乎会把之前重新生成的回复作为上下文发送。ai有时会忽略这样发送的上下文，但是有时似乎思维仍然会受到这样发送的上下文影响。彻底删除某条消息可以管理上下文，但是很不方便，万一里面有想要的就很难办。

### 🧐 解决方案

在每条消息处增加是否在发送下一条用户提示时将本条消息拼接进上下文发送的复选框。同时添加折叠消息按钮，便于索引。

title: [Bug] When conversation output contains long code, cannot end current conversation after model finishes answering, then current conversation disappears and conversation cannot continue
body:
### 📦 Environment

Docker

### 📌 Version

latest

### 💻 Operating System

Ubuntu

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

### 🐛 Bug Description

如下用对话生成的Bug描述，当中包含了Python代码，这个对话就会已知卡在无法结束的状态，然后进入对话消失，无法继续对话的状态。只能刷新页面，开启新的对话。
部署环境是Oracle的 ARM机子，Ubuntu24系统。Docker Compose部署

## Bug 描述

**概要:**

当对话中包含较长的 Python 代码块时，模型在回答完后无法正常结束当前对话，随后该轮对话消失，且该对话无法继续。短代码或纯文本对话正常。

**重现步骤:**

1. 开始一个新的对话。
2. 向模型提问，该问题应诱导模型输出包含较长 Python 代码块的回答 (例如："请帮我写一个计算斐波那契数列的 Python 程序，要求可以计算到第1000项")。
3. 等待模型输出完整的代码和解释。
4. 尝试继续对话。

**预期结果:**

* 模型在输出完较长的 Python 代码后，对话仍然可以继续。
* 用户可以继续输入并获得模型的回复。
* 对话记录能够正常保存和显示。

**实际结果:**

* 模型输出完较长的 Python 代码后，当前对话似乎卡住，无法继续输入。
* 过了一段时间后，该轮对话消失。

**示例:**

**触发 Bug 的示例对话:**

> 用户: 请帮我写一个计算斐波那契数列的 Python 程序，要求可以计算到第1000项。

> 模型: 
> ```python
> def fibonacci(n):
>   """
>   这个函数用来计算斐波那契数列的第 n 项。
>   """
>   if n <= 0:
>     return "输入必须大于 0"
>   elif n == 1:
>     return 0
>   elif n == 2:
>     return 1
>   else:
>     a, b = 0, 1
>     for _ in range(3, n + 1):
>       a, b = b, a + b
>     return b
>
> # 输出前 10 项进行测试
> for i in range(1, 11):
>     print(f"fibonacci({i}) = {fibonacci(i)}")
>
> # 计算第1000项
> print(f"fibonacci(1000) = {fibonacci(1000)}")
> ```
>
> (模型完成输出后，对话卡住，随后这一轮模型的回复消失了)

**正常运行的示例对话:**

> 用户: 你好！

> 模型: 你好！

> 用户: 今天天气怎么样？

> 模型: 今天天气晴朗，阳光明媚。

**备注:**

* 简单的 "Hello, World!" 程序或纯文本对话不会触发此 Bug。
* (可选) 尝试过的解决方案: (请在此处描述您尝试过的解决方案，例如：刷新页面、重启浏览器等)

**截图/录屏:**

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/db998c5c-211f-4397-9243-858b09155172)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e7acccd8-36c6-42dd-a008-f7686bb84f8d)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f759d1c7-58cc-443c-ae5f-af26dccbc7c5)

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

**重现步骤:**

1. 开始一个新的对话。
2. 向模型提问，该问题应诱导模型输出包含较长 Python 代码块的回答 (例如："请帮我写一个计算斐波那契数列的 Python 程序，要求可以计算到第1000项")。
3. 等待模型输出完整的代码和解释。
4. 尝试继续对话。

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

**预期结果:**

* 模型在输出完较长的 Python 代码后，对话仍然可以继续。
* 用户可以继续输入并获得模型的回复。
* 对话记录能够正常保存和显示。

body:
### 📦 Environment

Docker

### 📌 Version

v1.51.1

### 💻 Operating System

Windows

### 🌐 Browser

Edge

### 🐛 Bug Description

When talking about a math problem it generates response, and then the error page shows.

Response text:

> <think>
> 
> 好，我现在得解决这个关于数列的问题。题目给定了一个正向数列{aₙ}，首项a₁=4，递推式是aₙ² = a_{n+1} + 3n aₙ -3。任务分成两部分，首先是根据前几项求出a₂和a₃，再根据这三项的规律来猜出通项公式；第二就是用数学归纳法证明这个猜想正确的。让我仔细分析一下，一步步解决这个问题。
> 
> 第一部分，求a₂和a₃，然后再猜通项公式。首先，我应该根据递推式来计算a₂的值。注意，这里给出的递推式是aₙ的平方等于后面的项a_{n+1}加3n乘aₙ减3。那么，对于n=1的情况，即当用a₁来计算a₂的时候，我们可以代入到递推式中。让n=1：
> 
> a₁的平方等于a₂加上3*1*a₁减去3。现在已知a₁=4，代入进去，4² = a₂ + 3*1*4 -3。计算左边是16，右边是a₂ + 12 -3，也就是a₂ +9。所以方程就是16 = a₂ +9，解得a₂ = 16 -9 =7。对吗？得核对一下运算是不是哪里错了。
> 
> 结果是a₂=7，因为1)带入n=1，式子变成 a₁² =a₂ +3*1*a₁ -3 →4²= a₂ +3*4 -3 →16= a₂ +12 -3 →16=a₂+9 →a₂=7。对吧？
> 
> 接下来求a₃的话，需要使用a₂的表达式，然后带入n=2时的递推式，同样的方式解出a₃。这时候式子应是a₂² =a₃ +3*2*a₂ -3，根据已知，a₂=7，则带入得：7² = a₃ +3*2*7 -3 →49= a₃ +42 -3 →也就是49 =a₃ +39 →解得a₃=49-39=10。所以a₃=10。
> 
> 现在前三个项是a₁=4，a₂=7，a₃=10。现在要看这三个数的规律，猜想通项公式。他们之间可能隐藏的规律可能是线性的？即相邻两项的差，例如7-4=3，10-7=3，这样下一个可能是a₄=13？或者是否存在某种数列类型。
> 
> 不过根据题目给出的递推式比较特别，不是线性的递归，而是带有平方项的，是否可能通项公式为一次函数形式，例如 aₙ = 3n +1？
> 
> 看一下是否是这种可能的，比如当n=1时，3*1+1=4，确实符合a₁=4；当n=2时，3*2+1=7，符合a₂=7；当n=3时，3*3+1=10，也符合a₃=10。看起来像是aₙ=3n +1，那么这个猜想似乎合理？或许呢？
> 
> 好的，接下来是证明部分，需要用数学归纳法来证明这个猜想。
> 
> 首先，数学归纳法需要两步：基础步骤和归纳步骤。基础步骤要证明当n=1时命题成立，即a₁=4=3*1+1=4，成立。这是正确的。
> 
> 那么归纳假设设为当n=k时，a_k=3k+1，这假设成立，进而需要证明n=k+1时a_{k+1}=3(k+1)+1=3k+4是否成立。
> 
> 然而要注意原题使用的是递推式a_n² = a_{n+1} + 3n a_n -3，其中原式中n的范围从1开始到所有自然数。所以，应采用归纳推导出当假设a_k=3k+1成立时，证明a_{k+1}=3(k+1)+1=3k+4.
> 
> 这个过程可能需要将归纳假设代入递推式进行计算。
> 
> 但是需要注意这一点不一定直接可行，因为对于给定的递推式，可能需要从n到n+1时的依赖关系来导出后的项是否符合。这个过程需要详细推导是否正确。或者说： 假设对于任意的n=k，a_k=3k+1，那么递推式a_k² =a_{k+1} +3k*a_k -3里面的a_{k+1}会等于什么呢？
> 
> 带入a_k=3k+1，左边a_k²=(3k+1)^2=9k² +6k +1；右边则是a_{k+1} +3k*(3k+1) -3.
> 
> 根据等式：9k²+6k+1 = a_{k+1} +3k*(3k+1) -3.
> 
> 右边的计算: 3k*(3k+1)是9k² +3k，整个右边的表达式为 a_{k+1} +9k² +3k -3。此时左边等于右边，所以方程是：9k² +6k +1 = a_{k+1} +9k² +3k -3.
> 
> 简化的话，可以先对两边约去相同的项。左边的9k²=右边的9k²，剩下的左边是6k +1，右边对剩下的项是 a_{k+1} +3k -3。
> 
> 这样就得等式：6k +1 = a_{k+1} +3k -3.
> 
> 把左边的6k +1 变成右边的话，则a_{k+1} +3k -3=6k +1 →解，移项得a_{k+1}=6k +1 -3k +3=3k +4。因此，这个过程对吗？
> 
> 这样可以得出 a_{k+1}=3k+4=3(k+1)+1，即确实满足 a_{k+1}=3(k+1)+1。这说明如果n=k时，a_k=3k+1成立，则n=k+1时，a_{k+1}=3(k+1)+1成立。这说明通过数学归纳法，对于所有自然数n≥1，该公式成立。
> 
> 那看来这个猜想是对的，所以问题得以解决。
> 
> 但有一丝问题：是否有可能前几项符合某个规律但后面不符，这题设置显然是通过递推式给出的，且替换正确的情况下，这里归纳法是应用正确的？是的，因为在递推式之下，每个项都依赖前一项，因此数学归纳法适合这种情况。
> 
> 总之，第一步求出a₂=7和a₃=10，前三项呈现出线性规律：aₙ=3n+1。通过数学归纳法验证，当假设n=k成立时，n=k+1也成立，所以整个通项公式成立。
> 
> 现在需要系统化地把这个过程整理下来。
> 
> 
> **答案**
> 
> 1. 代入递推式求得a₂=7，a₃=10。猜想通项公式为$\boxed{a_n = 3n + 1}$。
> 
> 2. 数学归纳法证明过程如下：
>    - **基例**：当n=1时，a₁=4=3×1+1，成立。
>    - **假设**：当n=k时，a_k=3k+1成立。
>    - **递推**：将a_k代入递推式得：
>      \[
>      (3k+1)^2 = a_{k+1} + 3k(3k+1) - 3
>      \]
>      计算得a_{k+1}=3(k+1)+1，即通项公式对n=k+1成立。
>    - **结论**：猜想成立，通项公式为$\boxed{a_n = 3n + 1}$。
> </think>
> 
> ### 知识点回顾
> 
> 1. **递推数列求解**：通过给定的递推关系式依次计算数列的项。
> 2. **数学归纳法**：一种证明方法，用于验证某命题对所有自然数成立。
> 
> ---
> 
> ### 详细解题步骤
> 
> #### 问题1：求 \( a_2 \)、\( a_3 \) 并猜想通项公式
> 
> 1. **计算 \( a_2 \)**  
>    根据递推式 \( a_n^2 = a_{n+1} + 3n a_n - 3 \)，当 \( n=1 \) 时：
>    \[
>    a_1^2 = a_2 + 3 \cdot 1 \cdot a_1 - 3
>    \]
>    已知 \( a_1 = 4 \)，代入：  
>    \[
>    4^2 = a_2 + 3 \cdot 1 \cdot 4 - 3 \implies 16 = a_2 + 9 \implies a_2 = 7
>    \]
> 
> 2. **计算 \( a_3 \)**  
>    当 \( n=2 \) 时，代入递推式：
>    \[
>    a_2^2 = a_3 + 3 \cdot 2 \cdot a_2 - 3
>    \]
>    已知 \( a_2 = 7 \)，代入：  
>    \[
>    7^2 = a_3 + 42 - 3 \implies 49 = a_3 + 39 \implies a_3 = 10
>    \]
> 
> 3. **猜想通项公式**  
>    观察前三项：\( a_1 = 4 \)，\( a_2 = 7 \)，\( a_3 = 10 \)，可见 \( a_n \) 是线性递增的，首次差为 \( 3 \)。因此猜想通项公式为：
>    \[
>    a_n = 3n + 1
>    \]
> 
> ---
> 
> #### 问题2：用数学归纳法证明猜想
> 
> 1. **基例验证 (n=1)**  
>    当 \( n=1 \) 时，\( a_1 = 3 \cdot 1 + 1 = 4 \)，与已知相符。
> 
> 2. **归纳假设**  
>    假设当 \( n = k \) 时，\( a_k = 3k + 1 \) 成立。
> 
> 3. **归纳步骤 (证明 \( n = k+1 \))**  
>    根据递推式，将 \( a_k = 3k + 1 \) 代入：
>    \[
>    (3k + 1)^2 = a_{k+1} + 3k(3k + 1) - 3
>    \]
>    展开并化简左边：
>    \[
>    9k^2 + 6k + 1 = a_{k+1} + 9k^2 + 3k - 3
>    \]
>    消去 \( 9k^2 \)，并整理：
>    \[
>    6k + 1 = a_{k+1} + 3k - 3 \implies a_{k+1} = 3k + 4
>    \]
>    这正是 \( n = k+1 \) 时的猜想通项：
>    \[
>    a_{k+1} = 3(k + 1) + 1
>    \]
> 
> 4. **结论**  
>    由数学归纳法可知，通项公式对所有自然数 \( n \) 成立。
> 
> ---
> 
> ### 最终答案
> 
> 1. **计算结果与猜想**：
>    \[
>    a_2 = 7,\quad a_3 = 10,\quad \boxed{a_n = 3n + 1}
>    \]
> 
> 2. **数学归纳法验证成功**：
>    \[
>    \boxed{a_n = 3n + 1}
>    \]

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

Send the math problem.

> 设正向数列 $ { a_n } $ 的首项为 $ 4 $ ，满足 $ a^2_n = a_{n+1} + 3na_n - 3 $.
> 
> 1. 求 $ a_2 $ 和 $ a_3 $，根据前三项的规律猜想该数列的通项公式
> 2. 用数学归纳法证明你的猜想。



### 🚦 Expected Behavior

title: Docker v1.51.4+  页面静态化问题反馈（NextAuth 登录、FEATURE_FLAGS 、请求500 报错等）
body:
## 背景

基于 RFC https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/5461 ，我们在 1.51.4 版本实现了页面路由的静态化，这个版本更新带来的好处是首屏页面加载能进入 1s 内，二次进入能做到百毫秒级别，进而实现页面的秒开体验。

但由于在这个版本我们尝试了一种新的路由架构来支持 RFC 中提到的效果，因此可能存在一些问题需要实践检验。目前已知的问题有：

环境变量（FEATURE_FLAG、MODEL_LIST） 失效（1.51.13 修复）：
 - #5797 
 - #5811

NextAuth 集成失效（1.51.13 修复）：
 - #5801 
 - #5803

`/` 频繁报错，无法跳转登陆页（1.51.15 修复）
 - #5828
 - https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5837

`/discover/assistant/[id]` 500 （1.51.6 修复）
- #5809
- #5794

`/settings/provider/[id]` 500 （1.51.10 修复）
- https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/pull/5807

`/file/[id]` 500 (1.51.11 修复)
- https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/pull/5812

如果大家还遇到其他问题，欢迎在下面留言补充，我争取第一时间修复。

~~针对上述问题，临时解法是锁定到 **v1.51.3** 版本，等我把几个核心问题修复后再升级上来。~~

目前可以尝试 1.52.0 版本

body:
### 🥰 需求描述

请问如何在部署项目的时候 就默认模型开启状态  比如下面截图中  我想在我的服务打镜像包启动之后  直接默认只显示openai和deepseekai的模型列表
而不显示Ollama  我现在的版本为"version": "1.51.1"

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e617ba77-38b8-4357-9961-a69af6d2f2c6)

### 🧐 解决方案

 我该如何在项目启动的时候在模型列表直接屏蔽类似Ollama  而不是去应用设置里选择开启关

### 📝 补充信息

我尝试在环境变量里添加模型列表的配置OPENAI_MODEL_LIST: -all,+gpt-4o-mini,+gpt-4o,+gpt-4-turbo,+deepseek-chat,+deepseek-reasoner
添加上面配置后我发现 当我选择的deepseek-chat的时候 默认请求的是openai的接口

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/882ca7da-5d7a-4dba-b128-2650c88920cf)
